title: moderation.actioned v1 payload
description: A moderator decided a case (or an overturned appeal reverses one); the owning content service enforces it. owner_id and reason were added additively.

owner_id.description: Who the decision is about (added by T7); null when the case never learned its owner.

reason.description: Optional, additive: the note the moderator chose to share with the owner ("" when none). Sent on a moderator's decision; an appeal reversal leaves it out. Never the reporters or the appeal text.
